scope: local review binding only; no API, signing identity, merge or deployment
limits: Observations are synthetic; the future fixed API collector must establish their completeness and authenticity.
Output is unsigned and cannot authorize a merge or activation.
Manifest bytes are bound, but their operational schema is the separate release validator responsibility.
Before any authority consumes this binding, the manifest validator must match consumed sources and artifacts to the signed attestation, not merely validate its schema.
